messages:
Alex Chen: Originating RC: candidate v2026-03-20-rc3. Need signoff for quiet window 21:00-22:00 PT and staged promote. Pinning artifact: inference-service:sha256:abcd1234. Please ack to queue.
Maria Patel: Quick Q — any DB migration included? if yes we need 30m earlier freeze.
Alex Chen: No DB migration. Just runtime + model roll, no schema changes.
Jordan Lee: Added smoke tests to the canary job, ran locally — looks good.
Lina Gomez: QA heads-up: saw a rerank flake on long inputs — I dropped a reproducer in #eng-ml. Would prefer 10% canary for 30m.
Alex Chen: Thanks Lina. Plan: 10% for 20m, 50% for 15m, then 100% for 5m with dark-traffic fallback.
SRE Sheriff: @Alex Chen confirm rollback policy and deadman behavior?
Alex Chen: Rollback plan: immediate traffic flip to previous pinned tag inference-service:sha256:prev999, blacklist new variant from routing, stop autoscale triggers. No DB work needed.
Deploybot: [scheduled] RC create request accepted. Candidate: v2026-03-20-rc3. Pinned artifact inference-service:sha256:abcd1234. Deployment window: 2026-03-20T21:00:00-22:00 PT. Canary plan: 10% 20m -> 50% 15m -> 100% 5m. Rollback: immediate traffic shift to prev. Reaction required: :thumbsup: to queue.
Maria Patel: :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: :thumbsup:
Lina Gomez: QA ack — will validate after canary.
Priya (QA Lead): We'll run the prioritized eval set. Abort conditions: regression >3% on eval metrics OR p99 latency >350ms.
Alex Chen: Noted thresholds. Adding quick runbook snippet:
```
if error_rate > 1% for 5m -> switch to prev
if latency_p50 > 200ms and p99 > 350ms -> pause rollout and investigate
```
SRE Sheriff: Added sheriff oncall rotation: @SRE Sheriff will monitor. Deadman: if no :eyes: reaction in 10m after canary -> auto rollback.
Deploybot: Promotion scheduled at 2026-03-20T21:05:00 PT for canary. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 1809994444`
Alex Chen: Also updating release notes: short summary, migration: none, known issue: rerank flake on long inputs.
Maria Patel: I'll push the release notes to GH release and ping infra.
Jordan Lee: One more infra note — routing needs kv_warm for 5m pre-rollout to avoid cold p99 spikes.
Alex Chen: Done, added kv_warm hook.
Lina Gomez: QA will post final signoff in this thread after canary.
Priya (QA Lead): Running eval now.
Priya (QA Lead): QA: canary at 10% looks clean, no regression on eval set. :rocket:
Alex Chen: Moving to 50% in 5m.
Deploybot: Canary at 50% started.
Priya (QA Lead): 50% stable — no perf/quality regressions observed.
Alex Chen: Promoting to 100% now.
Deploybot: Promotion to 100% complete. New traffic: 100% -> v2026-03-20-rc3.
SRE Sheriff: Observability: error rate and latency stable. Holding for 10m.
Priya (QA Lead): Final QA signoff: all green. Release notes published: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/v2026-03-20-rc3
Maria Patel: Thanks team — closing quiet window and marking RC promoted.
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. If anything customer-facing pops up, file an incident and tag this thread for follow-up.
